meta.title: Prowatt Madagascar — Solar energy, water and electric mobility
meta.description: Standalone, hybrid, on-grid and anti-load-shedding solar solutions, water access, Ecooter electric scooters and an equipment shop in Madagascar.

100-autonome.name: 100% standalone solutions
100-autonome.short: Total independence from the grid, day and night.
100-autonome.intro: Solar installations with no grid connection: panels, lithium batteries and inverters sized for green electricity with no outages, no monthly bill and no voltage fluctuations.

hybride.name: Hybrid solutions
hybride.short: Solar, batteries and grid or generator working in harmony.
hybride.intro: Solar and batteries combine with the grid or a generator for continuous power, with automatic management of the sources.

ongrid.name: On-grid solutions
ongrid.short: Use your own energy and cut your bill.
ongrid.intro: Grid-connected solar plants that produce and consume on site. Ideal for businesses, shops and buildings already connected that want to lighten their bill.

anti-delestage.name: Anti-load-shedding solutions
anti-delestage.short: Batteries take over the moment the power stops.
anti-delestage.intro: For homes, shopkeepers and industries fed up with scheduled outages: a battery kit that switches over automatically and keeps your equipment running.

acces-a-eau.name: Water access
acces-a-eau.short: Solar water heaters, drilling and solar pumping.
acces-a-eau.intro: Solar water heaters and solar submersible pumps, accessible to everyone, for hot water and water supply without relying on the grid or fuel.
